data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series A defense and security company founded by Florian Seibel, Uwe Horstmann, and Johannes Schaback, having raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 same-sector and adjacent-stage comparables, comprising 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Stage-progression methodology was not applied due to data quality concerns: the reported $4.0B post-money valuation implies an $8.0B Series B value, which would represent an implausible 80x multiple on the company's $100M+ total fundraising. Peer-median valuation anchoring proved applicable, drawing on a set of 10 Defense & Security stage-peers with valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B. The median peer valuation is $1.0B; sample references include Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B (Series B).

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The analysis rests on a single method and thus carries material uncertainty around stage-specific risk adjustment and company-specific differentiation relative to peers. Validation against revenue multiples or capital efficiency metrics would strengthen confidence in this range.
